info.name: VisionGuard Digital Watcher API
info.description:
Click through the folders from 00 to 14 in order. Each request saves the ids the next one needs (see the collection variables). Every request has tests: the Test Results tab shows PASS.

Before starting: pnpm migration:run, pnpm seed, pnpm start:dev, and choose the environment "VisionGuard local".
For the two upload requests in folder 08 set Postman Settings -> General -> Working directory to the project folder.
